project.purpose: Own one bounded Agent Run's durable cognition, provider/tool interaction, action admission, effect binding, recovery, and completion proposal without owning caller Task meaning or Runtime physical truth.

nodes.label: RunContract
nodes.responsibility: Bind one exact Harness Run contract, provider/tool affordances, budgets, and caller context.
acceptance: A run is independently identifiable and bounded.

nodes.label: ContextProjection
nodes.responsibility: Compile current model cognition from durable working set, current ingress, and attempt context rather than replaying complete history.
acceptance: Context can be rebuilt from bounded owned sources.

nodes.label: ActionAdmission
nodes.responsibility: Turn model/tool proposals into exact admitted actions without treating intent as authority.
acceptance: Unadmitted proposals cannot become tool effects.

nodes.label: EffectBinding
nodes.responsibility: Bind admitted tool intents to physical evidence while preserving ambiguous-effect semantics.
acceptance: Lost response does not cause blind duplicate effect.
Live A/B MemoryRuntime H04 fixture admits only exact requestId-to-digest replay, disjoint edit intervals, and one producer per file; malformed requests cannot emit a successful effect receipt.

Temporal Worker deployment derives four exact runtime package versions solely from the installed requirements freeze, rejects stale/invalid source projections, and evaluates runtimeVersionsExact using one observed interpreter state per Plan.

nodes.label: HarnessProviderSPI
nodes.responsibility: Expose a prepared-attempt executor seam so alternate mature harness engines can be integrated without moving Task/Runtime authority.
acceptance: A second harness implementation can run behind the same caller-facing contract.
A replacement adapter must not require stronger caller/environment authority assumptions than the admitted HarnessRunContract and provider binding declare.

A replacement adapter must preserve required guarantees: admitted Tool surface cannot widen, UNKNOWN cannot become retry permission, Provider transport success cannot become semantic completion, and Runtime/Task authority cannot move into the adapter.

slices.objective: Prove a Harness Provider SPI with one alternate executor adapter while preserving Run/Task/Runtime authority boundaries.
acceptance: Native/current harness and one alternate adapter satisfy the same prepared-run contract without schema changes in caller Task or Runtime.
Assume-guarantee review shows every replacement assumption is already discharged by the existing Run/provider environment or is explicitly rejected.
Fault/ambiguity characterization shows the alternate adapter does not weaken no-blind-redispatch, Tool-authority, completion, or Runtime/Task ownership guarantees.
slices.nextAction: Freeze the H05 assume-guarantee obligations, then test one alternate adapter for both positive compatibility and negative substitutability before promoting the SPI.

slices.objective: Falsify transitive Tool authority and monitor-to-stop assumptions across admitted Harness effect consumers.
acceptance: No Agent message, Tool response, or chained service call is interpreted as a new authority grant.
Detector observation, stop request, process termination, and external-effect reconciliation are tested separately.
A missing consumer/effect oracle remains UNKNOWN, never promoted to PASS.
slices.nextAction: Reuse existing Harness action/effect tests with a fault-injected indirect-service consumer; do not add a new admission service.

gaps: A general alternate-harness adapter has not yet been accepted by evidence in this plan.
